context:
Goal: a yes you give through the coordinator lets the acting session act.
Why you: your 13:10 CST ruling in runner 8's chat needs a home in .claude/CLAUDE.md. Auto mode refused the coordinator's edit of that file, the default you kept at 12:38 CST, so only you can write it.
Departs from: main, where no grant covers a relayed yes — adds the bullet below under "## Standing grants", above "Acts the cloud refuses".
Note: auto mode may still refuse a relayed merge after this lands; the bullet gives it the grant to read.
Steps: open the link. Paste the bullet below on the line under "## Standing grants". Press Commit changes, pick "Create a new branch", then Propose changes. Then press Done here.

- **A relayed yes** (owner, 2026-11-07 13:10 CST, in runner 8's chat, until withdrawn: "a yes passed on by
  coordinator should literally be enough"). When the claude-settings coordinator relays an owner yes to a
  session it started, that yes is the owner's grant for the act it names. It covers that act only, never a variant.
title: Paste the relayed-yes grant into .claude/CLAUDE.md
why: Your 13:10 CST words in runner 8's chat: "a yes passed on by coordinator should literally be enough".
